alate: Alate head nearly square, the sides and the middle of the posterior margin rather straight, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded; the inner margin of each mandible with two marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly longer than the first marginal tooth, the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible fused with the second marginal tooth and longer than the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth; labrum short, broad and tongue-shaped. Antennae with 16–19 segments, the third not larger than the second or fourth. Compound eyes rather large, projecting beyond the lower margin of the head capsule, with a pair of ocelli adjoining them on the inner side. Postmentum a slender rectangle, broad in front and then narrowing, the sides parallel, the waist near the middle. Pronotum transversely rectangular, short and broad, slightly wider in the middle and posterior parts of the sides, wider than the head capsule, the middle of the anterior margin with a broad arcuate notch, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave and narrower. The forewing scale large, its anterior margin projecting, covering the hindwing scale; the radius sector with five to six branches, the subcosta shorter, the radius reaching less than or nearly half the total length and about twice as long as the subcosta; the media sclerotised, arising from the radius sector within the wing scale, running close to and parallel with the radius sector to the wing tip; the cubitus with about ten branches. The media of the hindwing sclerotised, arising from the cubitus outside the wing scale, rather far from the base or absent, close to the radius sector, the cubitus with two to four forked branches. Legs slender and long, tibial spur formula 3:3:3, an arolium between the claws, cerci with two segments.
soldier: The soldier has the head capsule yellowish brown, slightly paler behind; mandibles blackish brown, labrum and antennae white-yellow, postmentum pale yellowish brown with brown margins, pronotum, legs and abdominal tergites pale yellow, the whole body sparsely haired.
